episodes.title: Almost Okay
episodes.summary: When a suspicious shipwreck draws the eyes of the law, the fractured Buckley family must put aside their grievances to cover their tracks.

episodes.title: Taking Control
episodes.summary: Cane and Harlan take bigger risks to keep the business running. Bree seeks proof to confirm her suspicions about her family.

episodes.title: Playing with Fire
episodes.summary: As Harlan re-enters a risky alliance tied to the family's past, Belle makes quiet moves to protect what's left of their legacy.

episodes.title: You Can't Trust a Buckley
episodes.summary: Cane works to contain the growing fallout at home. Harlan connects with a new player — and learns the rules of the game have changed.

episodes.title: I'm a Hugger
episodes.summary: As pressure mounts and operations get riskier, Belle and Harlan struggle to keep a low profile. Old wounds resurface between Cane and Bree.

episodes.title: Hunting Season
episodes.summary: Belle receives upsetting news about the family's future. A hunting trip troubles the fragile alliance between Harlan and Grady. Bree makes a confession.

episodes.title: Nice Try
episodes.summary: Hoping to regain control of his operation, Harlan tries to outmaneuver an imminent threat. A violent warning shakes the Buckley family to its core.

episodes.title: Lost at Sea
episodes.summary: As tensions flare, a dangerous standoff at sea brings the Buckleys face-to-face with their enemies.
